entries.title: Gaining an intelligent edge
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2021, the global market for the intelligent edge will expand to US$12 billion, continuing a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of around 35%.
entries.subject: Edge computing

entries.title: The cloud migration forecast: Cloudy with a chance of clouds
entries.quote: we predict that revenue growth will remain at or above 2019 levels (that is, greater than 30%) for 2021 through 2025 as companies move to cloud to save money, become more agile, and drive innovation.
entries.subject: Cloud computing

entries.title: 5G is not hazardous to your health
entries.quote: We predict that in 2021, it is very unlikely that the radiation from 5G mobile networks and 5G phones will affect the health of any single individual
entries.subject: 5G health effects

entries.title: The next-generation radio access network: Open and virtualized RANs are the future of mobile networks
entries.quote: Although deployments are starting slowly, they could easily double in 2021.
entries.metric: global active public-network Open RAN deployments
entries.subject: Open RAN and network virtualization
entries.note: The chapter text is split across columns in the PDF; the quote is reassembled. Deloitte's 2025 Updates article restates this prediction as 'global active public network Open RAN deployments would double from 35 to 70'. The chapter also cites an outside estimate that open RAN will approach 10% of the RAN market by 2025.

entries.title: Women's sports gets down to business: On track for rising monetization
entries.quote: In 2021, we predict women's sports revenues will be well under a billion dollars ... we predict that women's sports will grow to be worth a great deal more than a billion dollars in the years ahead.
entries.subject: Women's sports

entries.title: The hyperquantified athlete: Technology, measurement, and the business of sports
entries.quote: we predict that by the end of 2021, multiple professional sports leagues will establish new formal policies around the collection, use, and commercialization of player data.
entries.subject: Sports athlete data

entries.title: TV's New Year's resolution: 8K
entries.quote: We predict that 8K—an upgrade and complement to 4K resolution—will generate US$3.3 billion in global revenue in 2021
entries.subject: 8K television

entries.title: From virtual to reality: Digital reality headsets for enterprise and education
entries.quote: We predict that, led by purchases by corporations and educational institutions, sales for enterprise and educational use of wearable headsets for VR, AR, and MR ... will grow by 100% in 2021 over 2019 levels.
entries.metric: enterprise and education XR headset sales vs 2019
entries.subject: Extended reality headsets

entries.title: Video visits go viral
entries.quote: We predict that the percentage of total visits to doctors that are done virtually via video will rise to 5% globally in 2021, up from an estimated 1% in 2019.
entries.metric: share of doctor visits done by video
entries.subject: Telehealth (video visits)

notes: 20th edition by count from 2002. Nine predictions ('All nine of our TMT Predictions topics', foreword). The Deloitte Insights edition URL serves the full report PDF. Chapter subtitles for 5, 6, 7, 8 are paraphrased from the contents page where the PDF gives only the short title. Rank is the order in the report.
